scene: The friendly pilot unrolls a transit map across the railing.
picture: Side-view of a lower transit junction platform beneath the tower. On the left hangs a dangling chairlift seat. The boy in his orange vest stands mid-left. In the centre waits an open red sleigh tram on rails. On the far right, a glass-bottomed boat bobs beside a mooring post.
shown: a dangling two-seat hillside chairlift swinging empty on the left
a frost-dusted red sleigh tram idling with doors open in the centre
a sleek glass-bottomed boat tied to the dock on the far right
